<thought>Since the simple query returned no templates, I will broaden the search to include both ketones and C‑C double bonds as functional groups broken, while still requiring formation of an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring. This should capture carbonyl‑ene templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
